title: Kennedy
description:
Brink of War, The (October 1962 - June 1963)
Bringing the country back from the brink of nuclear war, Kennedy pursues diplomacy with the Soviets and decides to address civil rights in a way no president has before: as a moral issue.

title: Kennedy
description:
Legacy, A (June 1963 - November 1963)
The final months of John F. Kennedy's life and the legacy he left behind.

description:

title: Weapons at War
description:
Amphibious Warfare
From the swamps of Florida to the sands of the Persian Gulf, trace the development of these machines and relive their glorious moments in battle including Iwo Jima and Normandy.
